gameDescriptionHtml:
Become the Ultimate Warrior Mage. Wield mighty weapons and unleash devastating magic as you grapple, glide, fight, and explore across a mysterious world.

Discover Legendary Weapons – The Master Sword. The Lich Hammer. There are whispers of many more. Find them and their powers are yours: each with unique traits suiting a variety of different playstyles.

Unlock Ancient Magic – Soul Crests are ancient magic items that hold the essence of long-forgotten warriors. Collect them to learn their power: and live your wildest battlemage fantasies.

A Lovingly Crafted Metroidvania World – Grapple, Glide, Summon Platforms and more! Find Artifices to unlock the world and discover its deepest secrets. Experience the thrill of exploration with the challenge of platforming.

Game Features

  • Fully-voiced story. Every line of dialogue is performed by a talented cast of voice actors.
  • A living world, where each biome has its own theme, lore, dangers, and challenges.
  • Interconnected map. Explore as you wish. Gain abilities to unlock areas. Find shortcuts, hidden passages, and more.
  • Quests, quests everywhere! Find characters to help and mysteries to solve throughout the world. But beware: your choices have consequences.
  • Memorable boss fights. Bosses will test you to your limits. Beating them will require skill, tactical-thinking, and unlocking the full potential of your weapons and powers.
  • Choose your build. Mix and match various weapons and different powers to create a build that reflects your playstyle. Each unique weapon has stats that can be unlocked by defeating enemies and upgrading at the vendor.
